headline: Verlinvest launches technical tender offer to buy out Oatly JV partner
summary: Verlinvest announced a technical tender offer to facilitate the buyout of its joint-venture partner's stake in Oatly Group AB, advising public shareholders not to tender their shares as the offer price sits substantially below market value.
why: Verlinvest is an anchor shareholder in plant-based milk producer Oatly; JV restructurings can precede shifts in governance and ownership control.

impacts.name: Oatly Group
impacts.why: The technical buyout offer is aimed at resolving a partner stake, with investors advised not to sell below market.
